rootCause: The phase's plan does not specify a stop condition the codex reviewer accepts; each round adds new feedback because the acceptance bar is missing.

options.label: Add an explicit acceptance checklist to the phase plan
options.description: Prepend an 'Acceptance' section listing test commands + lint checks; codex stops requesting changes once all items are check-marked.

options.label: Lower codex review iteration cap to 3 and escalate to plan-mutator
options.description: On cap-hit, mutate the plan via plan-mutator rather than retrying the same review loop.

learnedPatternProposal.pattern: codex review round \d+ changes-requested\n.*iteration cap reached
learnedPatternProposal.description: Codex reviewer never converges because the plan has no explicit acceptance criteria.
